purpose: Canonical contract for reconciling public-statement evidence into stable Evidence Roots, traversals, discovery gaps, Episodes, Development Threads, and deterministic reference projections.
ownership_rule: Source ledgers own captured wording and provenance. Existing Bible relation files own comparison interpretation. This manifest owns reconciliation, rooted identity, structural traversal, function-thread, and reference-projection contracts. Generated Root, Discovery Frontier, Episode, Bible projection, and Development Thread files must be rebuilt rather than hand-edited.
root_invariants: Exact captured wording is never rewritten by reconciliation.
More precise time evidence may strengthen a Root without deleting weaker provenance.
Timestamp equality alone never merges statements.
Recovered external status IDs strengthen a Root without renaming its canonical ID.
Ambiguous joins remain open gaps rather than guessed matches.
Timeline order is a traversal over Roots, not the canonical identity order.
Source loading order must not change canonical output.
Episodes resolve existing Roots; they never create or rewrite statement evidence.
Candidate Episodes remain descriptively bounded and carry no interpretive claims.
Bible relations join through existing occurrence IDs rather than quote similarity.
Episode Bible inheritance means member-union only and never implies a sequence-level relation.
Bible relation interpretation remains owned by the established relation files.
Candidate Development Threads use explicit literal terms only.
Every Development Thread attestation records the exact terms that caused membership.
Function threads remain separate from actor/title assignments and carry no interpretive claims while candidate.

episode_policy.membership: inclusive UTC bounds over existing second-precision Roots
episode_policy.promotion_rule: Theme, Bible, role, or causal interpretation requires a later testing pass and is not part of candidate Episode construction.

development_thread_policy.membership: case-insensitive explicit literal terms with word boundaries
development_thread_policy.ordering: existing Timeline traversal over member Roots
development_thread_policy.promotion_rule: Broader functional interpretation requires a later testing pass; candidate membership itself establishes only explicit source-language recurrence.

claim_boundary: The Evidence Root records what was supplied, how records reconcile, and what remains unknown. It does not establish supernatural identity, prophecy fulfillment, or the truth of theological claims contained in source statements.
